To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
CAPs are a form of industry self-regulation that have been developed by the alcohol industry in partnership with local authorities.

(1) CAPs are a partnership between local authorities and the alcohol industry; (2) they have been implemented in 100 towns across England and Wales since 2011, with 50 new CAPs being set up in 2018/19; (3) CAPs are funded by local alcohol licensees who pay an annual levy; (4) CAPs are not a new concept but have evolved from previous alcohol partnerships and have been adapted from the USA; and (5)
the purpose of CAPs is to reduce alcohol-related harms among young people.
